title: RailBlock AI — User Journey & Workflow (v1.0.1-prototype)
prototype_disclaimer: Synthetic demo data only. Not autonomous control. Synthetic prototype windows, not official railway availability.
stack: React 18 + Vite + React Router + FastAPI + Pydantic + SQLAlchemy + SQLite WAL + OR-Tools CP-SAT + Recharts

steps.ui: Synthetic banner, Tasks 30 Windows 134 feasible, health wal

steps.fields: priority_score, rank, band, S,U,C,O,D,R, P=0.30S+0.20U+0.20C+0.15O+0.10D+0.05R + historical Δ

steps.status: FEASIBLE 134 / REJECTED 34 Train overlap / Goods ≥0.7 HARD

steps.conflict: Protected interval [departure-buffer, arrival+buffer) overlap=train_start<block_end && train_end>block_start, exact boundary no overlap

steps.optimization: Baseline FCFS (no grouping) vs CP-SAT x[tid,wid] y[gid,wid] task≤1 window≤1 resource/date dependency ordering 5s 8 workers → OPTIMAL, fallback greedy

steps.validation: 14 checks A-L + grouping, POST /api/plans/{id}/validate → valid:true else violations 400

steps.editing: PATCH /api/plans/{id}/draft-blocks/{blk} {service_date, reason, editor} → 200 else 400 TRAIN/RESOURCE, 409 stale expected_version, AuditEvent old/new

steps.approval: POST /api/plans/{id}/submit-review DRAFT→UNDER_REVIEW 200 else 400, POST .../approve {CONTROL_OFFICE} → 200 APPROVED else 401/403, VIEWER 403, AuditEvent+Notification

steps.department_view: GET /api/approved-plans?department=ENGINEERING, GET /api/plans/{id}/department-view?department=TRACTION → my_blocks 7/5/6 integrated 13/15/14, CONTROL_OFFICE 0/20, no leak

steps.execution: POST /api/blocks/{BLK-*}/execution {actual_start, actual_end, status, completed_task_ids, service_date, recorded_by} → 201 else 200 idempotent / 409 diff / 400 WND / 404 unknown / 422 malformed, no 500, EXE-* + Block/Task statuses

steps.replanning: POST /api/plans/{id}/replan {reason} → new_plan_id preserved 19 displaced 2 new TSK-2000, Execution history preserved, 409 stale

steps.metrics: GET /api/metrics/{id} → blocks, asset_downtime/available/availability_pct, completion_rate, planned/actual/variance, baseline/optimized/improvement, formulas documented

state_machines.plan: DRAFT → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED → PUBLISHED → SUPERSEDED, REJECTED
state_machines.block: GENERATED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED → PUBLISHED → COMPLETED/PARTIALLY_COMPLETED/CANCELLED → LOCKED

deployment: D:/PROJECT2/MAYBE/RAIL/backend/railblock.db WAL, ./start.ps1 / bash start.sh [clean|health|status|logs|stop], docker-compose.yml healthcheck python -c urllib, CI setup-python 3.11 + pytest + setup-node 20 + eslint + tsc + build
